NoGames: No games added. Scan Steam or select an executable manually.
AddGameHelp: Add a game to select and check local resources.
ExeHelp: Select the actual game executable. Its directory may differ from the installation root. Confirm the graphics API; architecture is read from the file.
SteamScanScope: This development build scans Steam. Select the game and confirm its EXE. Other stores can be added manually.
PreflightHelp: Check first, then write to the game. Unchecking a library does not remove its deployment.
NotWrittenYet: Game files have not been modified. Review the actual changes below.
OverwriteConsent: Continuing backs up existing originals before deploying the entire library. Identical contents are not silently claimed.
ProtectionConsent: Continuing saves and verifies changed targets before changing or clearing the deployment. Copies are not written back to sources, merged into the new version, or kept active in the game automatically.
SkipLibraryHelp: To skip a library, cancel this confirmation, uncheck that library and run preflight again.
RecoveryHelp: Check the interrupted operation and restore its previous state. New target changes or unavailable protection data stop recovery and keep the game locked.
LibraryExplanation: Libraries reference your local sources. Saving configuration does not deploy, move or modify source files.
NoLibraries: No libraries yet. Add a library and version on the Libraries page.
ConfigOnly: Saving affects future plans. Existing receipts retain the actual locations previously written.
ReShadePending: This development build supports ordinary files and folders. ReShade EXE extraction and INI adaptation are not connected yet. Source executables are never run.
NoMigration: Data is stored here. Automatic migration is not available. If disconnected, reconnect the same data set.
ProtectionRetention: Modified copies and their path records are retained without automatic expiry. Originals and recovery snapshots are separate and must not be treated as disposable cache.
CurrentScope: Ordinary file deployment, version changes and clearing; manual games and Steam discovery. Dedicated ReShade adaptation and other store scanners are pending. Automatic Vulkan ReShade management is excluded from v1; ordinary resources are unaffected. OptiScaler is copied as ordinary files; BAT files are not run.
LicenseNotice: RHI-CS includes code adapted from RankFTW/RHI under GPL-3.0. Provided without warranty. You may modify and redistribute it under the license conditions. The license and source notices are included with the application.
DataExplanation: Choose an empty folder for configuration, deployment receipts, original backups and protected modifications. Do not choose a game or resource source directory. Cancelling leaves deployment disabled.
BootstrapExplanation: Only a data-location pointer is stored in your system user directory. Deployment data and backups stay in the location you choose.
Busy: Working. Wait or request a stop. Other pages remain viewable.
TaskEnded: Task ended. Results can be reopened.
CloseDuringTask: Wait for completion, or request a stop and restore the current library. Completed libraries stay deployed; remaining libraries will not run. Close the window after recovery finishes.
NeedsRepair: Repair required; changes to this game are locked
CommittedJournalPending: Deployment committed; operation journal needs reconciliation.
DataUnavailable: Application data is disconnected or incomplete. Reconnect the original data.
DataChanged: Application data differs from this session. Reopen the application.
WrongDataSet: This is not the original data set.
EmptyDataFolderRequired: Initialization requires an empty data folder.
MigrationNotSupported: Automatic data migration is not supported.
BootstrapInvalid: The data pointer is damaged. Initialization stopped to avoid creating an empty ledger.
LocalAbsolutePathRequired: Choose a fully qualified path on a local drive.
OverlappingPaths: Data, source or game target locations overlap.
UnsafeRelativePath: The relative path is unsafe or contains a reserved Windows name.
ReparsePoint: The path contains a link or reparse point and is blocked.
FileDirectoryConflict: A file conflicts with a directory at the target.
TargetConflict: Different libraries cannot own the same target file.
GameExecutableTarget: This development build cannot replace the selected game EXE.
GameUnavailable: The game directory or executable is unavailable.
GameIdentityChanged: The game location or EXE changed. Old originals cannot be restored automatically.
GameRunning: The game may be running. Close it and run preflight again.
InvalidExecutable: Cannot verify the selected executable's architecture.
ManagedLocationLocked: Clear or repair existing deployments before changing game locations.
EmptySource: The source directory has no files to deploy.
AdapterNotAvailable: This resource adapter is not connected yet.
BackupUnavailable: A required backup is missing or failed verification. Operation blocked.
ChangedSincePreflight: Sources, targets or configuration changed after preflight. Check again.
DuplicateLibrary: A batch cannot include the same library twice.
InsufficientSpace: Insufficient free space for protection data.
SpaceCheckFailed: Cannot confirm free space. Operation blocked.
InspectionFailed: Inspection failed; deployment has not started.
ConsentRequired: Confirm original backup or modification protection.
RecoveryTargetChanged: Recovery target has new, unknown changes. Overwriting stopped.
NameRequired: Name or version label cannot be empty.
HardLinkTarget: The target has multiple hard links. Overwriting is blocked.
